experiment_data.hypothesis: Random selection baseline (K=10, pick uniformly at random) on LIBERO-Spatial seed42. On Object, Random K=10 (11.3%) ≈ VLA-only (10.9%), proving CRM guidance is the value. Tests whether same pattern holds on Spatial: if Random ≈ VLA-only (~29.6%), CRM's +5pp is from guidance not sampling diversity.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/acr-vla-conformal-refinement && HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 MUJOCO_GL=egl python -u src/evaluate.py --mode random_selection --benchmark spatial --seed 42 --n_rollouts 10 --K 10 --crm_checkpoint /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/crm_v3_norm/obs_only/crm_best.pt --max_correction_norm 0.2 --output_file logs/eval_random_selection_spatial_seed42.json 2>&1 | tee logs/eval-random-selection-spatial-seed42.log"
